files.player_base: everything (all optional nodes, all four gloves, both hands per side)
files.player_coach: base coach (1B/3B): uniform, helmet visible by default (Gear_Cap and Gear_LineupCard optional), wristbands, no glove
files.player_manager: manager: older face (default morphs build_stocky .55, cheeks_full .6, brow_heavy .5, eyes_deep .5, jaw_square .3, nose_large .3), gray hair, team jacket `Gear_Jacket` over the uniform, `Gear_Beard_Stubble` (gray) visible, optional `Gear_Beard_Full` / `Gear_Mustache` / `Gear_Hair_Buzz`
files.player_ballkid: ball kid: polo, shorts, cap, 1.55 m (Armature node scale 0.838, extras cb_height_m), slimmer build default (build_lean 0.55), no glove; `bat_donut.glb`: weighted warm-up donut `Bat_Donut` (bat frame, sits at 0.50 m from the knob)
files.player_umpire: plate umpire (navy, mask, chest protector, shin guards)
files.player_umpire_base: base umpire (navy uniform and cap only)
files.note: in the glove files the node `Gear_Glove` is that role's glove, `Glove_Pocket` its pocket, `Hand_L` the open hand that lives inside it and `Hand_R` the ball-ready claw hand; each lod1/optimized/plain variant of a file has the same content

head: head_narrow
head_wide
morph_targets.note: influence 0..1 (mouth_open: 1 = a natural talking / shouting opening, larger openings would expose the jagged MPFB mouth interior). body keys on every skinned body/clothing mesh; head keys on the Head and every head-attached mesh (hair, caps, helmet, mask, beards, brows, lashes, teeth; the key set per node differs: expressions only on Head / Eyebrows / Eyelashes / Teeth / Tongue / beards); eyes_look_* on `Eyes` and `Eyes_Cornea` (both globes turn together, 22 deg left/right, 18 deg up/down); fingers_n on Hand_R (n fingers extended, index first); glove_open/closed on the glove, its laces and the hand inside; hair_under_cap squashes hair under a cap. All head / face keys are MPFB2 (CC0) targets re-fitted to our rig, see CREDITS.md

grips.Ball_Grip: RightHand, 4-seam (ball symmetry axis toward the thumb side); show the claw hand
grips.Elbow_Pole_L / Elbow_Pole_R: Spine1, origin = where each elbow sits in the batting stance (swivel target for hand IK)
grips.Glove_Pocket: LeftHand, origin = pocket centre (where the ball sits, 5-8 mm clearance from the leather), glTF +Y = pocket opening normal, +X along the fingers; Glove_Pocket_Outfield / _FirstBase / _Catcher in player_base

headwear: Gear_CapLogo (stitched logo on the cap front, own material cap_logo)
hand: Hand_R (fist for the bat in player_batter; claw holding the ball in the glove files; relaxed otherwise)
Hand_L (fist / relaxed / the open hand inside the glove)
node_groups.note: every node carries glTF extras {cb_group, cb_default}; cb_default = 1 means visible in that file's pre-configured look. Optional variants exist only in player_base.glb

jersey_decals.note: Four thin patches that conform to the jersey (1 mm above it), skinned like the jersey, own UV 0-1 and own material; the engine replaces the material's baseColorTexture with a canvas texture per player (RGBA, straight alpha, alphaMode MASK cutoff 0.5: draw fill + outline in the team colours, leave the rest transparent). Text is written STRAIGHT: the arch of the name is baked into the mesh. Texture aspect = patch aspect (no stretching). Placeholder textures (white text, navy outline: PLAYER / 27) ship in the files; the old baked numbers (Gear_Number_Tens/Ones, material jersey_number) stay in the files, hidden by default (cb_default 0), as fallbacks. LOD1 files keep only Jersey_BackNumberDecal.

Jersey_BackNameDecal.text: LAST NAME in capitals, block letters ~7.5 cm cap height (3 in) in a 9 cm band, max width 0.36 m including the outline: scale the font down for long names (up to 14 letters: letters ~2.3 cm wide at 36 cm); u runs left to right as seen from behind (wearer's left to right), v up; arch radius 0.45 m (ends 3.6 cm lower than the centre, letters fan out radially, +-11 % width top vs bottom)

Jersey_BackNumberDecal.text: 1-2 digits, 24 cm (9.5 in) tall, centred; two digits ~11 cm wide each; u left to right as seen from behind

Jersey_FrontNumberDecal.text: 1-2 digits ~11 cm (4.5 in) tall, on the wearer's right chest (viewer's left), u left to right as seen from the front

Jersey_SleeveNumberDecal.text: 1-2 digits ~7.5 cm (3 in) tall on the left upper sleeve, v points toward the shoulder, u runs toward the back (as seen from outside)

headwear_nodes.Gear_Helmet: batting helmet (ABS shell, short bill, ONE ear flap on the left for a right-handed batter, ear opening) + Gear_HelmetLogo (front patch, material cap_logo); player_catcher exports the hockey-style catcher's helmet under the name Gear_Helmet (Gear_Helmet_Catcher in player_base)
headwear_nodes.Gear_CatcherMask: catcher's wire cage (hockey style, 4 horizontal + 3 vertical bars, forehead pad); player_umpire exports the traditional umpire mask (6 + 5 bars, forehead / chin pads, two straps) under the same name (Gear_UmpireMask in player_base)
headwear_nodes.material_mask: mask = coated steel bars; mask_pad (second material slot) = pads and straps

materials_recolor: face (same atlas as skin: recolour both with the same baseColorFactor)

hair (+ hair_short01, hair_short03, hair_short04, hair_bob01, hair_afro01, hair_long01, hair_ponytail01: luminance-normalised strand textures, recolour all `hair*`; `hair_beard` = opaque fibre texture of Gear_Beard_Full / Gear_Mustache / Gear_Goatee)
eye (iris colour is in the texture; alternative iris colours: players/textures/eyes_<colour>.webp)

extra_textures.eyes_<colour>.webp: optimized/players/textures/eyes_brown|hazel|green|blue|gray.webp: equirect iris textures to swap onto material `eye`
extra_textures.skin_sss.webp: optimized/players/textures/skin_sss.webp: R = skin thickness (0..4 cm), G = curvature, same UV layout as the skin atlas (materials skin / face)

elbow_guides.node: Elbow_Pole_L / Elbow_Pole_R (children of Spine1: elbow position in the batting stance)

swing_bat_path.note: Bat_Grip of `swing` per frame in sim world coordinates (right-handed batter)

budgets.note: measured by src/perf_budget.mjs on optimized/players (lod0) and optimized/lod1 (lod1): triangles / draw calls of the nodes visible by default, morph memory (vertices x targets x 12 B), texture bytes in the file, estimated GPU texture memory (KTX2 ETC1S/UASTC counted as 8 bpp x 4/3 mips = worst case; 4 bpp on ETC2 / opaque ETC1S devices). `_texture_sharing`: identical textures (same sha1) across the files

lod1.contents: Body (material skin: Body_Skin + Head + hands merged, no morphs, no normal / ORM), Cloth (material lod_cloth: every garment / gear piece merged, colours in COLOR_0, per-vertex region id in the custom attribute _REGION), Gear_Hair (material hair), Jersey_BackNumberDecal (own material) + the armature and the grip / pole empties. No eyes / brows / lashes / teeth / beards / front or sleeve decals / animations (bone names are identical to the LOD0 file: drive them with the LOD0 clips).

6.name: black leather, belt, soles, masks, catcher gear

lod1.recolor: rewrite COLOR_0 of the Cloth mesh once per team from _REGION (e.g. team palette for regions 0 jersey, 1 pants, 2 socks, 3 undershirt, 4 cap / helmet, 5 piping); skin / hair are tinted with baseColorFactor like LOD0
